    AI Overview
    The 2026 Masters Tournament boasts a record $22.5 million total purse, with winner Rory McIlroy taking home $4.5 million. Second place earns $2.43 million, and third place receives $1.53 million. Professional players who missed the cut receive $25,000, while amateurs earn no money. 
    2026 Masters Payouts (Selected Positions) 
    • 1st: $4,500,000 — Rory McIlroy
    • 2nd: $2,430,000 — Scottie Scheffler
    • 3rd: $1,530,000
    • 4th: $1,080,000
    • 5th: $900,000
    • 6th: $810,000
    • 7th: $725,625 (T7 — Collin Morikawa, Sam Burns)
    • 8th: $697,500
    • 9th: $630,000 (T9 — Max Homa, Xander Schauffele)
    • 10th: $607,500
    • 11th: $562,500 — Jake Knapp
    • 12th: $427,500 (T12 — J. Spieth, H. Matsuyama, B. Koepka, P. Reed, P. Cantlay, J. Day)
    • T24: $178,071
    • T33: $132,750 
    Payouts are generally distributed among the top 50 players (plus ties), with amounts decreasing down the leaderboard.
